prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a huge ochre-yellow segmented worm bursting up from a low mound of sand, thick armoured ochre rings, the top end a four-part jaw that opens like a flower into four pointed lobes ringed with teeth; in every cell the raised front end stays well below the top of the grey box and the whole worm and mound sit in the middle of its own cell with empty space on both sides. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: no eyes; the four-part toothed jaw is the readable feature.

BASE: a low mound of pale yellow sand around its lower body is part of the creature's own body, drawn joined to it with a shared black outline in every cell and resting on the ground line as its ground contact; it is not a separate prop or scenery.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, the front end lunging down toward the heroes with the four-part jaw spread wide open, the mound in place, the jaw well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, the front end recoiling back and up, the four-part jaw clamped shut, the mound in place, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Coil and uncoil the body along a strong curve, strike the head and neck far toward the heroes or draw them back, and let the tail tip lash. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, coiled upright inside the box, the lowest coil resting on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, eyes, a face, legs, pink skin, purple skin, lava, a separate rock, flying sand.
